intents.intent: Plugin registry for language-specific extractors. Provides register_extractor, get_extractor, supported_extensions, and setup helpers for Python and JavaScript/TypeScript extractors.
Instantiate and register all built-in language extractors (PythonExtractor, JavaScriptExtractor) for the given project root
JavaScript/TypeScript/React extractor. Regex-based analysis for .js, .jsx, .ts, .tsx, .mjs, .cjs files. No external AST parser required.
Language extractor plugin for JavaScript, TypeScript and React source files
Initialize JavaScriptExtractor with the project root path
Return the list of file extensions handled by this extractor (.js .jsx .ts .tsx .mjs .cjs)
Extract all function, class, module and interface nodes from a JS/TS file
Extract nodes and import metadata from a JS/TS file and return a FileExtractionResult
Extract import edges from a JS/TS file as WorkflowEdge objects (one per unique import/require)
Parse a JS/TS source file using regex to produce Graph0Node list and ImportInfo list wrapped in FileExtractionResult
Return import-type WorkflowEdge objects for every unique import/require statement in a JS/TS file
Compute a short SHA-256 hash over a 500-character window of source text starting at match_start
Return the 1-based line number of the character at match_start within text
